plain: A man named Steve Coburn told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he remembers being on board a craft. He says he mostly saw different types of grays there. Grays are the small, grey-skinned beings with large heads and eyes that people often describe in these accounts. The story also has to do with one being he describes as his handler.
